instruction: Please help me find the score record for the 2020 Super Bowl in the NFL website.

metadata.explanation: Task variation asking to find 2020 Super Bowl scores instead of 2019. Uses the same NFL website navigation pattern with URL verification. The evaluator checks if the active tab URL matches the expected 2020 Super Bowl scores page (post4 denotes Super Bowl). Uses existing getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' and metric 'is_expected_active_tab' - no custom functions needed.
metadata.similarity_to_original: Very similar - only changes the year from 2019 to 2020, maintaining same complexity and navigation pattern

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' correctly extracts the active tab URL from Chrome's accessibility tree without requiring page reload or UI interaction
Metric 'is_expected_active_tab' correctly compares the result URL with the expected URL using the compare_urls utility function
Expected URL 'https://www.nfl.com/scores/2020/post4' is semantically correct for the 2020 Super Bowl scores page (post4 denotes Super Bowl as confirmed in metadata)
Evaluator checks the complete instruction requirement: finding the 2020 Super Bowl score record is verified by checking if the user navigated to the correct scores page
No runtime issues expected: getter uses accessibility tree (stable), metric performs simple URL comparison, no dependencies on dialogs or transient UI state
